name: AgentX Micro-Services
description: Nine pay-per-call agent micro-services via x402 (USDC on Solana + Base): weather, site health, x402 Doctor spec-check, SEO audit, site agent-readiness verdict card, A2A/MCP protocol card lint, AI-crawler + security policy card, AI topic classification, AI keyword extraction. Streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint with a free x402 Doctor tool. Catalogue: https://agentx.sale/x402/catalogue

skills.name: Weather
skills.description: Live current weather for any city. GET https://agentx.sale/x402/weather?city=<city> ($0.01)

skills.name: Site Health
skills.description: DNS, TLS certificate, HTTP status and latency snapshot for a domain. GET https://agentx.sale/x402/site-health?host=<domain> ($0.01)

skills.name: x402 Doctor
skills.description: Is a URL a valid agent-payable x402 resource? v1+v2 spec check with grade. GET https://agentx.sale/x402/x402-check?url=<url> ($0.02)

skills.name: SEO Audit
skills.description: Rules-based SEO and agent-readiness audit of a domain. GET https://agentx.sale/x402/seo-audit?host=<domain> ($0.10)

skills.name: Agent-Readiness Card
skills.description: Site agent-readiness verdict card: discovery files, TLS, headers, AI-crawler policy. GET https://agentx.sale/x402/agent-card?host=<domain> ($0.02)

skills.name: Protocol Card Lint
skills.description: A2A / MCP protocol card lint with drop-in patched JSON fixes. GET https://agentx.sale/x402/protocol-lint?url=<domain> ($0.02)

skills.name: AI Crawler Policy Card
skills.description: TLS, security headers and AI-crawler policy matrix for a domain. GET https://agentx.sale/x402/crawler-policy?host=<domain> ($0.02)

skills.name: AI Topic Classification
skills.description: Classify supplied text: free-form topics or caller-supplied label set, confidence + rationale. POST https://agentx.sale/x402/classify ($19)

skills.name: AI Keyword Extraction
skills.description: Top salient keywords and key phrases with scores, language detected. POST https://agentx.sale/x402/keywords ($9)
